_comment: This file exists for the OLD Vercel project `orleu-mangistau-kdi`, which has
no Root Directory set and therefore reads the repository root.
That project is a leftover Vite build whose only remaining job is to host the
original site's photographs, which the new site still links to. It became
connected to this repository by accident; every push started a build there
that fails, because the Vite app it expects is not in this repository.
Two reasons to switch its automatic deployments off. The failures send the
owner an alarming email on every push, and far worse, a build that somehow
succeeded would replace the deployment currently serving those photographs
and they would disappear from the live site.
The new site is unaffected: its Root Directory is `site`, so it reads
site/vercel.json and never sees this file.
